name: Detect crypto price spikes and send AI-powered Telegram alerts

parameters.content:
## Crypto Price Spike Alerts
Watch the crypto market around the clock. When a top coin moves sharply, AI writes the take and Telegram delivers the alert.

### How it works
1. The schedule trigger checks prices every 6 hours. Press Execute on the manual trigger any time to test.
2. The Configuration node holds every setting: currency, number of coins tracked, spike threshold, and your Telegram chat ID.
3. Fetch Market Data pulls the top coins by market cap from the free CoinGecko API. No API key needed.
4. Detect Price Spikes flags any coin whose 24h price moved beyond your threshold and ranks the movers.
5. Build AI Prompt and AI Market Take send the movers to OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) for a sharp analyst take.
6. Format Telegram Alert builds a Markdown message with the AI take and the movers list.
7. Send Telegram Alert delivers it to your chat. If nothing moved beyond the threshold, the workflow ends quietly with no alert.

### Setup
- [ ] Create a Telegram bot with @BotFather and copy the token
- [ ] Get your chat ID (message @userinfobot on Telegram)
- [ ] Get an OpenAI API key and add it as credentials on the AI Market Take node
- [ ] Add Telegram credentials on the Send Telegram Alert node
- [ ] Paste your chat ID into the Configuration node
- [ ] Activate the workflow with the toggle (top right)

### Customize
Raise or lower the spike threshold, track more coins, or change the check frequency in the Configuration node. Swap the Telegram node for Slack, Discord, or email to change delivery.

### 1 - Triggers and configuration
The schedule checks prices every 6 hours. Use the manual trigger to test any time. Edit every setting in the Configuration node.

### 2 - Fetch market data
Pulls the top coins by market cap from the free CoinGecko API, including 24h price change. No API key required.

### 3 - Detect spikes and AI take
Flags coins that moved beyond your threshold, ranks them, then OpenAI writes a sharp analyst take.

messages.content: You are a crypto market analyst. Write in plain language, no hype, no emojis, no financial advice.
={{ 'These coins moved sharply in the last 24 hours. Write 3 sharp one-line takes on what might be driving these moves.\n\n' + $json.moversText }}

### 4 - Format and deliver
Builds a Markdown alert with the AI take and the movers list, then sends it to your Telegram chat.
